posts.what: Over the open sea, one after another, three white paper darts of slightly different shape fly off: one dives into the water, one glides away, one flips over; no launch or rail can really be seen, and nothing else on the island changes.
posts.recipe: three shape variants of one object released over the sea, each behaving differently, camera watches
posts.shared: three shape variants compared over the open sea, each ends differently

posts.what: Fixed view of a dark slate board on the grass with three blue batteries on magnets, each with a bent copper wire: two wires turn round their batteries (slowed), the left one stays still; nothing else on the island changes.
posts.recipe: three variants side by side on a board, fixed camera, different outcomes
posts.shared: three variants side by side, fixed camera, each behaves differently; copper wire on slate board as in the wire bench
